geometry.coordinate_rule: Anchor is board water-plane center. Collision footprint90x28 is independent of above-water rider silhouette. Jump changes visual elevation only; shadow stays at water-plane anchor. Art supplies final pose/registration; no sprite stretch.

movement.inputs: Normalize input then multiply ride-only x400/y350, shared by both heroes/all modes; unchanged anchor bounds. Global movement unchanged.
movement.course_coordinate: World course x=scroll+screen anchor x; obstacle screen x=world_x−scroll. Relativeforward left160/right960 away from screen clamp; at clamp use actual position delta plus scroll. Preserve world obstacle positions;104 crossing times halve.
movement.pause: Pause freezes scroll, steering, jump, warnings, hazards, damage timers and audio; no catch-up.
movement.fire: Ignore fire/weapon actions throughout ride, preserve loadout for later scenes. Release guards prevent held transition inputs firing or auto-jumping.

jump.curve: z=4*72*u*(1−u), u=clamp(jump_age/1.2,0,1). Grounded z0 outside jump.
jump.input: Accept a fresh jump press while grounded, alive, active and cooldown0. No double jump, held repeat or coyote extension in this slice. Steering remains available in air.
jump.shadow: Render board/rider at water anchor minus z; shadow remains on water anchor and changes opacity/size. Collision uses planar footprint plus z, never screen-render position.
jump.release: A jump on landing dialogue dismissal is not accepted until input is released and pressed again.
jump.close_gate_timing: First two centers720/560=1.285714s apart are closer than1.2+.15 repeat minimum. Stagger first takeoff at center−.65 and second at center−.55, giving1.385714s spacing; do not use centered jumps for both. Same offsets relative to actual chosen screen anchor; Level Design validates all18 routes.

support.rule: Support footprint is hazardous at every jump height; steer around in bank direction. Swept board AABB versus support AABB; jumping never clears it. Not a rideable platform.
support.layout: Never block the entire permitted bank range. Leave a reachable gap at least board depth28 plus24px maneuver margin. Validate approaches from current reachable states, not merely one static lane.
support.impact: One normal hit, no attach/stand behavior. Do not stop forward scroll or permanently pin the hero. Collision is a contact hazard; hurt feedback and shared immunity allow the course to continue.

low_barrier.rule: Swept planar overlap causes damage only while z<28. At z>=28 board clears barrier. Full-width barriers are permitted only with adequate warning and feasible jump timing.
low_barrier.timing: Neutral full-board overlap114/560=0.203571s within unchanged above28 window0.938083s; preserve swept collision at actual harmful times.

gap.rule: Gap may span all water. If any board footprint overlaps unsupported water while z<=0, begin a fall. Take off before leading edge enters, land after trailing edge clears. Never use center-only gap collision.
gap.timing: Neutral full-board overlap150/560=0.267857s within1.2s jump. Failed clearance uses normal1HP/recovery; no gap auto-death. Validate shifted takeoff windows between closely spaced gates.
gap.failure: Normal1HP contact under shared immunity, never unconditional life loss. If alive afterward, recover at current water-plane anchor with0.6s visual board bounce/splash from existing artwork. Cancel the failed jump and apply normal0.15s landing cooldown; steering/scroll/course continue. Death only on actual HP depletion.

damage.simultaneous: Aggregate simultaneous obstacle overlaps, including gaps, into at most one health debit under shared1.5s immunity. Only actual HP depletion enters normal death once; no health=1 override or immunity reset to force a gap death.
damage.recovery: All obstacle IDs use one latch per traversal. First harmful contact latches even while already immune, with no deferred hit. If vulnerable, charge normal1HP/shared1.5s immunity. Keep latch until board trailing edge has passed obstacle downstream edge; clearing by bank sidestep is insufficient. Clear all latches on reset/retry. A different obstacle may damage after immunity expires. No teleport, global immunity, course skip, count change or timer pause.
damage.collision_order: Process actual harmful contact times in order with shared immunity. Stop on lethal damage before later contacts/finish. Exact jump landing over a gap is a normal gap-contact event, not unconditional death.
damage.gap_feedback: Nonlethal or already-immune gap contact records recovered and starts0.6s visual recovery. Cancel failed jump with0.15s cooldown; no life debit/restart/landing cue. Display bounce does not change collision anchor or disable steering. HP-depleting gap uses normal death and fall event, not recovered.

checkpoint.commit: Preserve the existing post-flush landing checkpoint before ride begins. Natural landing and direct landing entry reach the same ready state. Carry current health/lives; no free heal on first arrival.
checkpoint.retry: Death debits one life once, then restore full hero HP and course clock0 at landing checkpoint with standard3s immunity and cleared obstacles/jump/cooldown. Preserve selected hero/difficulty/loadout and deterministic course. Never replay flush or Clogfather.
checkpoint.game_over: Retry starts this ride checkpoint with standard3lives/fullHP; explicit New Game retains normal game-start behavior.
checkpoint.dialogue: Do not repeat long arrival/flush gag on retry. Begin with safe course lead-in after existing landing dialogue/ready boundary.
checkpoint.finish: At8100/560 seconds, after final contacts, latch safe completion once. Full8100px and counts retained; flush unchanged.

difficulty.shared: Physics, jump, contact damage and collision sizes identical across modes/heroes. Difficulty changes obstacle density and preview, not hidden hitboxes.
difficulty.course: Same world obstacles and halved104 crossing times. Clear lead0..900/560 and tail7560/560..8100/560. Warning targets unchanged except the explicitly approved opening clamping exception; no prestart hold or added course duration.

These are shorter than target, not full-lead compliance.
difficulty.randomness: First playable course is deterministic per mode with authored obstacle placements. Do not introduce random repositioning or adaptive hitboxes without separate validation.

audio_events.ride_landed: Successful board contact with supported water, never gap fall.
audio_events.ride_fell: Superseded for nonlethal gaps: use recovered/normal impact feedback and short board bounce. Existing death audio only on actual HP depletion.
audio_events.ride_finished: Successfulcourse-duration completion once; stop current loop.
audio_events.ownership: Audio maps provenanced existing cues; Engineering final event naming. No new music requested.

acceptance: Both heroes/all modes complete deterministic course through real movement/jump inputs with no injected immunity or damage bypass.
Test exact jump start/end and height28 crossing against support/low-barrier/gap rules; sweep high relative speed and long outer frames using fixed simulation substeps.
Board footprint rather than rider art/center determines gaps; neutral/right valid crossing, deliberately late or left-slowed jump can cause normal gap damage.
Supports cannot be jumped; low barriers can; bank steering route and no impossible full-width support wall.
No first arrival heal, death life debit once, fullHP checkpoint retry at course0, no flush replay; pause/resume/held-input guards/reset/finish idempotence.
Exact counts8/12/16 with scaled calm lead/end, actionable warning from forwardmost approach and tested combined obstacle routes.
Engineering integrates/builds and updates roadmap; Art owns rider/obstacle artwork, Audio owns cue mappings. No new build or screenshots claimed by this contract.
